_comment: Shaped like GET /api/cluster/counter/tables/qos?fields=counter_schemas on the ONTAP counter manager (verified present on ONTAP 9.19.1). ops/total_data/read_ops/write_ops are rate-typed (already a per-second value); latency is average-typed; a raw-only counter (total_ops_raw) is included so the point_sample path has something to exercise. Counter names only; no real identifiers.
